profile_and_units.chery_tx_0x0FA: Object 14, 625 T4 ticks, bytes 0–1 F7C4 big-endian at 4 counts/rpm or FFFF; native FD18.6 set and FD1A.14 clear. Bytes 2/3/5 from audited E4M3 native words in ordinary mode; no cruise or override. Nonzero native donor byte 7 flags have no GW mapping in this profile.
profile_and_units.chery_tx_0x278: Object 15, 1250 T4 ticks, byte 0 is 0.75 °C/count minus 48 °C or FF. Bytes 1–7 reserved as FF in this candidate; C0/C1 temperature consumer uses byte 0.
profile_and_units.chery_rx_0x1AE: Object 13, DLC 8, speed raw d[6:8] big-endian in 0.01 km/h; floor(raw/25)*32 in native Q7. Existing 32-service-call offline lease is not a physical-time calibration. Optional T4 chronology was independently retested.
profile_and_units.rb_0x5E8_0x5E9: Objects 11/12. Pinned R4 CRC-8/SAE-J1850, token, sequence and START/REFRESH/CANCEL. Historical bounds 1–64 unsigned Q8 counts and 1–30 duration codes of nominal 10 ms. Historical lease 3906 T4 ticks and release one Q8 count/128 ticks; this range is an existing protocol bound for the historical pair, not a release calibration for the current pair.
profile_and_units.rpm_permit: E4M3 S04 native FD18.6=1, FD1A.14=0 plus original RB CAN/T4 and F7C4 4800–26000 counts (1200–6500 rpm). Only checks the selected source flags; no new authority over actuator requests.
profile_and_units.t4: FF44[8:0]=0x046; FE44 low and E176 overflow high. Native fCPU/512. 40 MHz is the R4 nominal CPU assumption, not measured on this unit.
